The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the final marks for the Civil Services (Main) Examination 2025. This year’s results showcase a high level of competition, with the top spot secured by Anuj Agnihotri, who achieved a massive final total of 1071 marks.
We have verified the official merit list to provide you with the most accurate breakdown of the Top 20 candidates, their written scores, and personality test (interview) marks.
A deep analysis of the marks reveals several notable trends for aspiring civil servants:
Top Interview Scores: Within the top 20, Ishan Bhatnagar (Rank 5) and Zinnia Aurora (Rank 6) both secured the highest Personality Test (PT) marks of 215.
Mains Dominance: All-India Rank (AIR) 1 holder Anuj Agnihotri led the pack in the written total with 867 marks, providing a significant cushion for the final ranking.

Close Competition: The difference between Rank 7 and Rank 8 was marginal, with both Ar Rajah Mohaideen and Pakshal Secretry tied at a final total of 1035 marks, separated only by internal UPSC tie-breaking criteria.
